proposed_oracle_resolution.bootstrap_drain: Proposed sticky scalar event after a completed Gateway iteration proves constructor-queued bootstrap work is drained: Q0 requires queue_depth=0 and all-queue admission/pop/Run-entry/Run-return counts reconciled; Q1 requires only the registered future target remain at head and all non-target bootstrap work reconciled. The synchronous constructor Run is complete before the harness receives Process/GW.
proposed_oracle_resolution.empty_sample_point: Only at actual condition_variable::wait_for return after InputQueueMutex is reacquired, if StopGateway is false and InputQueue is empty; increment one saturating observation and event sequence there.
proposed_oracle_resolution.q1_correlation: WaitCapture and DecisionCapture are sticky; capture returned wait predicate value and the existing strict due/pop branch only; same iteration ID, increasing sequence and identical target/head/candidate scalar ID are required; overflow/mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE.
proposed_oracle_resolution.run_cardinality: Interpret N=1 as one GW consumer per condition; proposed paired experiment is two fresh, sequential Q0/Q1 process starts with distinct run IDs/journals/final records under one trusted service/lease. This interpretation is a review question, not execution authorization.
proposed_oracle_resolution.synchronization: One lock at existing admission/wait/pop sites; no recursive lock; scalar-copy accessor under InputQueueMutex; no observer Message*; counters saturate and overflow fails closed.
